prayerExcerpt.en-US: The Saints of God persevered in loving brotherhood, for there was always one spirit in them, and one faith.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Os santos de Deus perseveraram no amor fraterno porque permaneceram unidos num só espírito e numa só fé.

meta.face: Twin Syrian-Arab brothers of about thirty with warm olive-brown skin and the same dark almond eyes and gently aquiline nose, yet distinguishable. Cosmas (left): a broader, SQUARE-JAWED face with full cheeks and a wide mouth, heavier straight brows, short tightly waved black hair, and a short, sparse black beard along the jaw; he looks at the viewer. Damian (right): a narrower, HEART-SHAPED face — wide at the cheekbones, tapering to a small pointed chin — with finer arched brows, a smaller mouth, black hair a little longer and wavy to the ears, only a faint moustache and a wisp of beard at the chin; he looks toward his brother.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual gives the Anargyroi 'of Arabia' as dark, with little beard; the feast of 26 September keeps these Arabian twins of Cyrrhus. Brazilian devotion shows them young in red and green with palms and a box of medicine, the Western tradition with a flask and an ointment jar.
